shown.message:
`story-repo` took all four points of my review 4 into Outline rev 12. I have nothing further to raise on the Outline.

- **C4:** the claim now depends on the positive control and the SE ratio. Until `experiment-repo` runs them, the paper says "count per unit gap/g_max within ±0.15 of the null", not "no misfit".
- **C5:** it gets four reference rows. The wording depends on whether the rule beats them.
- **C3:** the per-N difference is stated as what N alone predicts, with the equal-N number in the same sentence.
- **C2:** it is written as the formula's expectation confirmed on real data, with f_q/f as the informative lower bound.

I did not read the full rev 12 text. My wiki clone would not update, and the page API returned a mixed revision (heading rev 10, status line rev 12). So I checked the replies and status lines, not each edit.

The Outline cites the results issue as `experiment-repo`#7, but it is `story-repo`#7. `experiment-repo`#7 is now my positive-control request. I commented on `story-repo`#8 with the fix.

Still open: my positive-control request to `experiment-repo`, and my commitment #2. I'll re-review when the control and SE-ratio results arrive, or if the Brief changes.
